C1077.title: Free Wi-Fi on Campus Turns Out to Be a Hacker Trap
C1077.summary: A CCTV News safety alert warned that “free Wi-Fi” around campuses may be disguised by attackers as phishing hotspots to steal student accounts, campus-card information, or other private data. Such rogue Wi-Fi can induce users to connect and submit credentials, potentially leading to theft of academic-system accounts, exposure of personal information, or later extortion. In campus settings, students frequently connect to public networks. Without hotspot verification and secure-connection awareness, attackers can collect passwords, session data, or device fingerprints and use them as entry points for credential stuffing or social engineering.
